en: Colorized illustrative postcard view of a large hilltop castle complex rising above a riverside town. The multi‑storey stone buildings with red tile roofs and towers sit on a high embankment with defensive walls, surrounded by trees and lower houses in the foreground. A calm river runs along the bottom edge. In the upper right corner, printed text reads "Schloß Colditz i. Sa." against a pale sky.
